result.query: SELECT json_build_object('lb_state',(SELECT state FROM network_load_balancers WHERE lb_id='lb_74f96109961444a48b26c31601e6131f'),'registered_service_uids',(SELECT json_agg(provider_uid) FROM network_lb_generated_resources WHERE lb_id='lb_74f96109961444a48b26c31601e6131f' AND kind='Service'),'active_eip_claims',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_eip_claims WHERE lb_id='lb_74f96109961444a48b26c31601e6131f' AND released_at IS NULL),'active_vip_intents',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_vip_intents WHERE lb_id='lb_74f96109961444a48b26c31601e6131f' AND released_at IS NULL),'active_subnet_refs',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_subnet_refs WHERE lb_id='lb_74f96109961444a48b26c31601e6131f' AND released_at IS NULL));
